title: Possessive pronouns: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs
en:
Possessive adjectives go before a noun: my, your, his, her, its, our, their + noun: This is my desk.

Possessive pronouns replace the noun: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs: This desk is mine. Is this pen yours?

Whose asks about the owner: Whose laptop is this? — It's Aigerim's / It's hers.

No apostrophe: yours, hers, ours, theirs, its (not your's, it's for possession).
ru: my / your / his / her / our / their — перед существительным (my desk). mine / yours / his / hers / ours / theirs — вместо существительного (It's mine). Whose…? — чей? Без апострофа: yours, hers, ours, its.

boss.situation: Describe who is responsible for what in your team: “This process is ours, that one is theirs…”. Use whose once.
samples: The risk register is ours, but the budget is theirs.
This procedure is mine — I wrote it last year.
The final approval is hers, because she is the head of department.
Whose task is the stock count? — It's his.
Is this report yours or Aliya's?
